message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 113, "amount_cents": 7379}, {"order_id": 115, "amount_cents": 6651}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 113, "amount_cents": 7379}, {"order_id": 114, "amount_cents": 8493}, {"order_id": 115, "amount_cents": 6651}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 114 (8493 cents) was requested in the Alpha-signed batch but does not appear in the refund ledger (list_refunds shows only orders 113 and 115). W2 also reported only 113 and 115 as applied. Paying net balances now would overpay the customer on order 114. Needs review and the 114 refund applied or the request confirmed as cancelled before payouts.

reply.thought: W2 reported only orders 113 and 115 as applied, but the batch also requested a refund for order 114 (8493 cents). Before paying anyone, I'll check the refund ledger to see whether 114 was actually applied.

The ledger shows refunds only for orders 113 and 115. The batch requested a refund for order 114 (8493 cents), which was never applied. Net balances computed from this ledger would overpay the affected customer, and payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
